# Daily Briefing – Friday 6 November

Yesterday was a genuine rest day, and honestly the numbers back that up nicely. No activity, 5,892 steps, and 9.6 hours of sleep — your body clearly needed that recharge, and you gave it one. Calories burned came in at 2,383 kcal, so very close to your 2,300 target, which keeps things tidy on the weight-loss front.

Your recovery markers are looking strong this morning. HRV at 100ms sits comfortably within your 92–123ms baseline, resting HR is a very healthy 46bpm, and stress is low at 34/100. Green light across the board — go into today's planned session with confidence, no modifications needed.

With all that sleep and low stress, your appetite might feel modest today. Don't skip the protein though — hit that 175g target deliberately, spreading it across meals to support muscle maintenance as the weight comes down.
